rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿００１That startled me...￥You heard that noise too, right?
＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿００２It came from inside the lab,￥didn't it?
＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿００５I just went to look, and...＝＠１７８＿００６it looks like Tomoe broke￥the data panel that shows￥the scores.

＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿００７Hmm... well, you see.＝＠１７８＿００８Tomoe's results were still up on￥the broken panel. Not really...￥what you'd expect from her.＝＠１７８＿００９She tends to brood over things,￥doesn't she? I've been worried￥about her for a while...＝＠１７８＿０１０For Tomoe of all people to￥take it out on things...￥it must be serious.

＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿０１１I know. Hard to believe, but...＝＠１７８＿０１２Tomoe's results were still on￥the panel. Bad ones, not like￥her at all.＝＠１７８＿０１３Taking it out on things isn't￥great, but...＝＠１７８＿０１４Failing at her best subject...￥Even I'd be crushed, I bet.
＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿０１５I'm glad you were the one here.
＊Natsuno＊＠１７８＿０１６Hey, please.￥Be there for Tomoe.＝＠１７８＿０１７I think she'd...￥open up to you.＝＠１７８＿０１８I'll clean up here.
＊Kaname＊＠１７８＿０２０Oh, Cousin.＝＠１７８＿０２１Did you just hear a weird noise?￥I think it came from the lab...
＊Kaname＊＠１７８＿０２４Hey...￥Did Tomoe look like she was￥crying just now...?
＊Kaname＊＠１７８＿０２８Tomoe's results are still up￥on the broken panel.＝＠１７８＿０２９They looked... pretty bad.￥And it's her best subject...＝＠１７８＿０３０That's gotta hurt. Even I might￥not bounce back for a while.
＊Kaname＊＠１７９＿００１Her results... were pretty bad.￥I could see them through the￥broken panel...＝＠１７９＿００２I'm not trying to pity her, but￥it's just too sad...
＊Kaname＊＠１７９＿００３Tomoe always tried so hard￥it almost hurt to watch...
＊Kaname＊＠１７９＿００４Hey... Cousin.￥Let's go cheer Tomoe up.＝＠１７９＿００５I can't just leave her alone.
＊Kaname＊＠１７９＿００６Come on, let's do it!＝＠１７９＿００７We should split up and look￥for her...＝＠１７９＿００８Okay, I'll check over this way!!

＊Tomoe＊＠１７９＿０１０Just leave me alone!￥I knew I couldn't do it!＝＠１７９＿０１１Someone like me...￥could never go to Elan!＝＠１７９＿０１２I can never do anything right!＝＠１７９＿０１３I can't carry everyone's hopes!＝＠１７９＿０１４No matter how hard you try...￥some dreams never come true!
＊Tomoe＊＠１７９＿０１８Because... because...＝＠１７９＿０１９No matter what I do, I never￥get it right...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７９＿０２１The people who get to go to Elan￥are the ones with real talent￥who can actually use it...＝＠１７９＿０２２Strong people...￥like you.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７９＿０２４There's no way someone like me￥could go to Elan...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７９＿０２６I was chosen. I came this far￥with everyone counting on me.＝＠１７９＿０２７If I can't go to Elan...
＊Tomoe＊＠１７９＿０２８Because...! I came all this way￥with everyone counting on me!＝＠１７９＿０２９If I can't go to Elan...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿００１I'm... scared of people being￥disappointed in me...＝＠１８０＿００２I really can't do anything...!
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿００５I see... That's it...＝＠１８０＿００６It's because I... can't believe￥in myself. Not all the way...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿００７I see... That's it...＝＠１８０＿００８Maybe I... still don't really￥understand my own ability...＝＠１８０＿００９And that's why I get so anxious.＝＠１８０＿０１０Yes... I'm sure that's it...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿０１１I never really understood￥this power of mine, and it's￥always frightened me...＝＠１８０＿０１２So I resented it... and I've￥never been confident in myself￥or my power...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿０１３But you're right...＝＠１８０＿０１４Of course I can't understand my￥power if I keep looking away￥from it like this.＝＠１８０＿０１５If I really face this ability,￥then someday, surely...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿０１６Oh... I-I'm sorry.￥You had to see me￥at my worst...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿０１７Well then... um...＝＠１８０＿０１８Thank you...￥for worrying about me.
